info.title: Eureka API
info.description: Research idea discovery and validation: investigations, ideas, evidence, papers.

post.description: Creates your account and logs you in.

Logs you in. A wrong email and a wrong password get the same answer, so nobody can find out which emails
have accounts; 5 failures in 15 minutes (per email or address) pause logins for a while.
Ends this session (its cookie stops working at once).
Changes your password and logs out your other sessions (this one stays logged in).

put.description: Your name and research limits. New investigations copy the limits; existing ones keep the copy they made.

post.description: Sends a new verification link (the older one stops working); at most one a minute.
Verifies the email from the link (no login needed: the link may be opened on another device).

Emails a reset link if the email has an account. The answer is the same either way, so nobody can find out
which emails have accounts.

Sets the new password from the link, logs out every session, and logs you in here. Opening the emailed link
also proves the email is yours, so it counts as verified.

Starts a new investigation: Eureka's first reading of the idea or field runs in the background (a few
cents), then the investigation waits for the clarification.

given); then the evaluation (Mode 1) or the discovery (Mode 2) runs in the background.

post.description:
Writes the research package for a finalist in the background (the Proposal Designer, one call, about 35
cents). A second call writes a new revision.

get.description: The full report as Markdown (PDF later), built from stored data: free.
The latest research package as Markdown (PDF later).

Everything the progress screen shows at once: the stage rail, counters from the database, cost against the
budget, the run state and how the last run ended.
The progress events after `after`, oldest first.

Live progress (Server-Sent Events): stored events after `after` (or Last-Event-ID), then new ones as they
happen, until the run ends.
